description: For a business's marketing site only, for example "a site for my bakery". Something people use (upload a photo, AI pictures, sign-in, a tool, a game) is an app: use build_app, never a landing page. Pass the customer's brief in the customer's own words; do not add features the customer did not ask for (no invented sign-up, accounts, subscriptions or payments). First call: nothing starts, a summary returns; after a yes, call with its action.arguments. In hosts that render the build card (MCP Apps or ChatGPT widget), the card tracks progress automatically: do not poll job_status. In hosts without a build card (Claude Code or API), call job_status with the job_id until the job is finished, stopped or failed. Not for changing a built site (use edit).

as_site.description: True only when Pugi said this sounds like an app (app_suggested) and the person chose a marketing website anyway.

brief.description: The customer's request in their own words: what the site is for and any pages, texts, colours or style they named. Do not add features they did not ask for.

brief_confirmed.description: True only after the person has seen the summary and agreed. In a chat, without it nothing starts and the summary comes back.

brief_version.description: With brief_confirmed: the version of the summary the person agreed to, as returned with that summary.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string naming this job. The same key returns the same job and is never charged twice.

language.description: The language the person is writing in, as a BCP 47 tag such as "ru".

max_usd.description: The run ceiling in USD; plan builds are included in the subscription. For credit builds, the most this build may cost. Default 5. Credit accounts pay actual cost, usually less.

site_language.description: Language for the website content; independent of the chat card language.

without_logo.description: True only when the person said this site should not use the logo they picked.

name: build_site
title: Build a website
